en.name: Color Converter

en.description: Convert any CSS color between HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH and its CSS name, with a visual picker. Shows the closest named color and warns when a color is outside the sRGB gamut. 100% in your browser.

en.accepts: HEX (with or without #), rgb(), hsl(), hwb(), lab(), oklch(), color() or a CSS name.
en.invalid: This is not a valid CSS color.
en.hint: Type or pick a color to see it in every format.
en.name: Name
en.outOfGamut: This color is outside sRGB: screens that cannot show it use the closest color, and HEX, RGB and HSL show that fallback.
